# anthropic_workspaces (Data Source)

Lists Claude Console workspaces in the organization (`GET /v1/organizations/workspaces`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Whether to include archived workspaces in the returned list. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `workspaces` (Attributes List) List of workspaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the workspace was created.
- `data_residency` (Attributes) Data residency settings of the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces--data_residency))
- `display_color` (String) Display color of the workspace.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the workspace.
- `name` (String) Display name of the workspace.
- `type` (String) Object type (`workspace`).

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces--data_residency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces.data_residency`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_inference_geos` (Set of String) Allowed geographies for model inference.
- `default_inference_geo` (String) Default geography for model inference.
- `workspace_geo` (String) Geographic region where workspace data is stored at rest.
